description: Read-only deployment-health evidence tools for an improvement-advisor agent over the Dagster+ GraphQL API, GitHub, PyPI and OSV.dev: project overview (assets/freshness/automation/schedules/code refs, retries, partition+check health, runtime changes, dependency/package risk, incidents), deprecated-API scan, latest Dagster release. Registers a resource and ships a stdio MCP server.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key the toolset is registered under.

deployment_url.label: Deployment Url
deployment_url.description: Full Dagster+ deployment URL, e.g. https://acme.dagster.cloud/prod. 'auto' derives it at run time from DAGSTER_CLOUD_DEPLOYMENT_NAME + the instance's Dagster+ organization -- resolvable for the plain resource (it sees the real DagsterInstance), but NOT for mcp_server_resource_key (that spawns a separate subprocess with no DagsterInstance at all): set deployment_url explicitly whenever mcp_server_resource_key is also set. An explicit value always wins.

token_env_var.label: Token Env Var
token_env_var.description: Env var holding a Dagster+ API token with read access to this deployment.

repo.label: Repo
repo.description: GitHub repository 'owner/repo' this deployment's code lives in -- required for deprecation_report and for project_overview's dependency/package-risk scan (pyproject.toml, lock files). Without it, deprecation_report refuses with a clear error and project_overview's dependency section is skipped with a note, rather than guessing.

github_token_env_var.label: Github Token Env Var
github_token_env_var.description: Env var holding a GitHub token with read access to `repo`.

github_api_base_url.label: Github Api Base Url
github_api_base_url.description: GitHub API base URL. Change for GitHub Enterprise Server.

base_branch.label: Base Branch
base_branch.description: Branch deprecation_report/the dependency scan read `repo` from.

exclude_paths.label: Exclude Paths
exclude_paths.description: Path prefixes deprecation_report's file scan and the dependency scan never read -- e.g. vendored code or generated files. Same directory-like ('src/')/filename-like ('Dockerfile') matching convention as github_pr_tools' exclude_paths/protected_paths.

exclude_locations.label: Exclude Locations
exclude_locations.description: Code location names project_overview refuses to review -- typically the improvement-advisor agent's OWN code location, so it never reviews or reacts to itself. Same name/convention as dagster_discovery_tools' own exclude_locations.

repo_notes.label: Repo Notes
repo_notes.description: Free text passed through project_overview's output verbatim, under `repo_notes` -- for what's deliberate in this deployment (a demo's artificial flakiness, a known limitation that isn't a bug). Same idea as the *_agent components' context_notes -- see litellm_agent/README.md's 'Telling the agent what's deliberate' section.

allow.label: Allow
allow.description: Hard allow-list of tools (default: all). Valid: project_overview, deprecation_report, latest_dagster_release.

max_result_chars.label: Max Result Chars
max_result_chars.description: Upper bound on the serialized size of any tool result.

retry_window_days.label: Retry Window Days
retry_window_days.description: project_overview's retried-steps lookback window, in days.

runtime_change_window_days.label: Runtime Change Window Days
runtime_change_window_days.description: project_overview's slower-than-before-runs lookback window, in days.

incident_window_hours.label: Incident Window Hours
incident_window_hours.description: project_overview's recent-incidents lookback window, in hours.

max_runs_scanned.label: Max Runs Scanned
max_runs_scanned.description: Upper bound on runs fetched per project_overview call (retries/incidents/runtime-changes all derive from this one fetch).

max_files_scanned.label: Max Files Scanned
max_files_scanned.description: Default cap on .py files deprecation_report scans (override per call with max_files).

osv_max_packages.label: Osv Max Packages
osv_max_packages.description: Upper bound on packages checked against OSV.dev per project_overview call.

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource under this key (python -m this module, with DAGSTER_EVIDENCE_TOOLS_* env vars set from this component's own config). Any mcp_servers-aware component can then reference it via server_resource_key.

mcp_extra_env_vars.label: Mcp Extra Env Vars
mcp_extra_env_vars.description: mcp_server_resource_key only. Extra env var NAMES to copy into the spawned MCP server's env.
